guitar.evidence: Steve Vai's Ibanez JEM signature series (with the iconic 'monkey grip' and 'Evo' guitar) is one of the most famous signature guitar lines in rock.

tone.target: liquid singing lead with delay, sustain, and subtle chorus sheen
tone.profile: liquid singing lead with delay, sustain, and subtle chorus sheen
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain emphasizing clarity (Comp/OD), followed by a clean high-gain amp model (US Deluxe) paired with lush modulation (Chorus) and expansive time-based effects (Digital Delay, Plate Reverb).
corrections: drop 'touch' of chorus; make delay and sustain central
aim for fluid Vai lead, not generic bright lead

rig.name: Steve Vai - Tender Surrender - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth out dynamics and enhance sustain for legato lead playing.
Add subtle grit and warmth to the clean arpeggios without sounding crunchy.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its smooth, non-aggressive boost character rather than heavy drive.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more aggressive option if the clean tone needs more bite.

blocks.purpose: Provide the requested subtle chorus sheen and liquid quality.
Provide controlled high-gain sustain for the lead lines without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is set to a low gain/high tone setting, acting more like a clean boost with added harmonic richness than a typical distortion pedal.

alternatives.reason: A safer alternative if the Red Haze sounds too complex.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a clean, articulate, and responsive high-gain platform suitable for Vai's style.
Provide a bright, focused, and articulate sound suitable for lead work.
Fine-tune the tone to ensure clarity and presence across all frequencies.
Create the wide, expansive delay crucial for the 'liquid' sound and sustain.
Add controlled space and depth without muddying the clarity.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the high-end articulation needed for Vai's lead tone.

proposals.reason: The current 'US 2x12' is generic; a specific, bright IR will enhance articulation and presence.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the high end.
